zh-CN.title: 聊天与广场共用链接卡片
items: 广场外部分享支持聊天中的全部链接卡片，包括一滴、小兜、Monifa 和普通网页。
发布预览、列表、瀑布流与详情共用卡片，保留播放、限时阅读和验证码刷新等交互。

en.title: Shared link cards across chat and Square
items: Square accepts every chat link card, including Drop, Pocklo, Monifa and ordinary websites.
Composer previews, feeds and details share the same cards, with playback, expiring diaries and refreshable codes.
